# The files whose change can change the pictures of scripts/screenshots.sh, as the
# paths of a workflow; a line that starts with ! leaves files out. After a push to
# main that touches one of them, the screenshot bot of the blueprint
# (screenshot-bot.yml) renders the pictures anew; it always counts the script, this
# list and .github/screenshots.toml as well. tests/test_consistency.py keeps the list
# in step with the key of the rendered images (tests/e2e/render_key.py) and with the
# visual check.
